# HomeStar Services & Contracting

> A Schluter Pro Certified residential remodeling company based in Fishers, Indiana, serving
> Hamilton County and the greater Indianapolis area. Design-build: in-house design, 3D renderings
> before demolition, permits pulled, licensed trades, and one contract for the whole project.

- **Location:** Fishers, Indiana, USA
- **Phone:** (317) 279-4798
- **Website:** https://www.thehomestarservice.com
- **Rating:** 5.0 across 78 Google reviews · BBB Accredited · BAGI member
- **Scale:** 100+ completed projects in Hamilton County
- **Service area:** Fishers, Carmel, Noblesville, Westfield, Zionsville, Geist, Fortville,
  McCordsville, Pendleton

## What HomeStar does

- Bathroom remodeling, kitchen remodeling, basement finishing, whole-home and multi-room
  renovation, flooring, decks and outdoor living
- Design-build under one contract, with plumbing and electrical performed by licensed plumbers
  and licensed electricians
- Complete Schluter waterproofing system (Ditra for floors, Kerdi for walls) on wet areas,
  backed by a 25-year manufacturer warranty
- Works to outside interior designers' and architects' drawings as well as its own in-house design
- Every client gets a private project portal: live phase status, selections tracked against
  allowances in real time, e-signed change orders, and a line-by-line final reconciliation in
  which unused allowance money is credited back to the homeowner

## Published pricing (Hamilton County, Indiana, 2026)

- **Kitchen:** minimum project $25,000. Cosmetic/basic $25,000–$50,000; mid-range/full
  $50,000–$100,000; premium custom $100,000+
- Cost calculators are published for kitchens, basements and general remodels (see Tools below)

## The team

- **Eric Farr** — Co-Founder. Estimating, business planning and development, client relationships.
- **Robb Rice** — Co-Founder. Construction quality, industry partner relationship development, and
  the real estate perspective from nearly 10 years as a licensed agent and investor.
- **Kristina W.** — Director of Operations. Previously owned and operated her own remodeling
  business, specializing in tile. Jobsite operations, trade coordination and scheduling.
- **Summer S.** — Project Coordinator. Nearly 10 years in residential design and project
  coordination. Client, designer and vendor coordination.
- **Miguel V.** — Carpenter. Nine years in remodeling and carpentry. Custom carpentry, finish
  work and on-site problem solving.
